dialogues.speaker: Vyazemskaya
dialogues.text: Whew! Thank goodness we lucked out this time!

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemskaya
dialogues.text: Yep! That monster was hauled in by our crew, and we set a new record! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemskaya
dialogues.text: The whole catch was a total nail biter, though. The beast nearly capsized the entire boat...

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemskaya
dialogues.text: But our crew is the finest fishermen in the entire harbor. The thing stood absolutely no chance against us in the end. Hehe, after all, we're Morepesok locals, born and bred!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you going to give an interview?

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemskaya
dialogues.text: An interview? Ugh, dealing with the crowd is way more trouble than hauling in a giant monster...

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemskaya
dialogues.text: I'll let my trusty chief mate handle all that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, I wish you good luck all the time!

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemskaya
dialogues.text: Luck doesn't ride with you forever. But if it did... I'd want it to follow you instead, my friend.
